final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN 0 - t.amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY a.frequency), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS overall_avg FROM step1) SELECT AVG(s.avg_signed_amount), AVG(s.avg_balance), AVG(s.avg_signed_amount - x.overall_avg) FROM step1 AS s CROSS JOIN step2 AS x WHERE s.avg_signed_amount > x.overall_avg
